title: The Strongest Solar Storm in 20 Years Lit the Sky Down to Florida

scenes.text: In 2024, the northern lights showed up as far south as Florida.
On May tenth, the Sun's flares sent a huge cloud of charged particles at Earth.
It hit the top of the scale, a G5 extreme storm, the strongest in over twenty years.
Auroras were seen in more than fifty-five countries, on all seven continents.
It even knocked farm tractors off their GPS, and some farmers had to stop planting.
The Sun sent a storm, and the whole planet lit up.

description:
In May 2024 the strongest geomagnetic storm in over 20 years pushed the northern lights as far south as Florida.
Auroras were reported in more than 55 countries.
Did you see them?
thumbnail_text: THE SKY LIT UP IN FLORIDA
